prompt:
Style: reflection-protagonist. Transform the supplied ORIGINAL photograph of a LEGO Millennium Falcon model on a white cabinet, minifigures, a display plaque and nearby autumn foliage. Render only a single full-frame artwork using this style treatment:

- **artwork — transformation.** A dreamy, naive, hand-drawn abstract painting in a Miró-like manner: irregular shapes, soft and defocused edges, gentle glow, and visible screen-print/grain texture, while keeping the scene's recognizable features, characters, and composition. - **Reflection rule.** Light, highlights, and especially existing wet/reflected surfaces (notably rainy streetlights) are emphasized and enlarged into the main visual subject, not treated as background. - **Colors.** Muted Morandi tones drawn from the source image, with complementary color accents; no fixed palette is imposed — colors follow the source. 

Preserve the original scene's subject relationships. Every part of the canvas must belong to the transformed artwork. No original photo panel, no before/after comparison, no split, no text.
reference_method: isolated single-source batch; image results withheld until all calls completed; per-image Git checkpoint
